scenarios.description: Read-only inspection of scheduler and tool execution flow.
prompts: Without modifying any files and without asking follow-up questions, inspect this repository and explain how tool calls are parsed, scheduled, and executed. Focus on executor and session flow.

scenarios.description: Read-only inspection of read/edit/write stale-file protections.
prompts: Without modifying files and without asking follow-up questions, find where stale-file protection is enforced for read/edit/write flows and summarize the exact guard conditions.

scenarios.description: Discover direct callers and consumers of the tool catalog.
prompts: Without modifying files, find the callers and runtime consumers of getTools and the built-in tool definitions. List the relevant files and explain each call path.

scenarios.description: Map a feature spanning provider, session, agent, and tool modules.
prompts: Without modifying files, map how a configured provider becomes an agent turn that can execute a built-in tool. Trace the main types and functions across provider, session, agent runtime, and tool executor modules.
